fundamental.summary: WFC shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk within 59 days.

risk.summary: WFC faces severe macro headwinds: VIX at crisis levels (396.64), flat yield curve signaling recession risk, rising dollar pressuring financials, and credit stress evident in widening spreads; earnings in 59 days adds moderate event risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: MACD/PPO crossover signals emerging momentum in extreme fear environment (VIX crisis, AAII 49%) with contrarian buy setup and price near support (37.876).
debate.key_bear_argument: Price remains below all key moving averages (EMA21, SMA21, EMA50, SMA50, 200EMA), RSI9 is weak (34.88), Ichimoku cloud provides overhead resistance, macro environment is severely unfavourable (VIX 396.64, flat yield curve, credit stress), and fundamental score is critically low (2/10) with high earnings risk in 59 days.
